info.title: maintenance-assistant API
info.description:
Search industrial maintenance protocols in natural language (DE/EN) and get answers with citations. Roles come from Keycloak; answers are filtered by role server-side.

[← Back to the application](https://maintenance.smartsupply.com.de/)

tags.name: Query
tags.description: Question answering over the indexed maintenance protocols

tags.name: Ingestion
tags.description: Upload and indexing of maintenance protocols

post.summary: Ask a question about one machine
post.description: Embeds the question, retrieves the closest protocol chunks for that machine and answers in one of two modes. Mode A is grounded: every claim carries the source it came from, validated against what was actually retrieved. Mode B is a labelled general suggestion, returned when no stored protocol is close enough. The answer is written in the language of the question, and its depth depends on the caller's role.

503.description: Provider unavailable or daily budget spent

200.description: Answered, in Mode A or Mode B

post.description: Stores the document on the volume, records it as RECEIVED and hands it to the indexer. Text files only — PDF and scan extraction is a later phase.

400.description: Unknown machine, bad field, or not UTF-8 text

post.description: Finds protocols in the given statuses and hands them to the indexer. Idempotent: re-indexing replaces a protocol's chunks rather than adding to them. Defaults to RECEIVED; pass FAILED to retry failures.

get.summary: Download the original document a citation points at
get.description: Streams the stored file from the volume. This is what makes a Mode A citation checkable rather than decorative.

404.description: No such protocol, or its file is gone

get.summary: What happened to the protocols you uploaded
get.description: The 50 most recent uploads of the calling user, newest first, with status RECEIVED / INDEXED / FAILED and the failure reason. Upload answers 202, so this is where a document becoming searchable is actually visible.

get.summary: List the machines a question can be asked about
get.description: Ordered by plant identifier. Unpaged: this is a fixed-size plant.
